conversation_before_the_call.text: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hi! I have a Light Blue checking account with you, but I want to swap it for something better — it’s pretty basic and I feel like I’m missing out on better perks. I already moved my money out of it. So I’d like to close it and open a new checking account with better benefits.

Oh, and I’ve also been meaning to open a savings account. I’ve saved up $6,000 and want to earn the absolute highest possible interest rate on it.

{
  "message": "I can help with this — but first I need to verify your identity before I can access or change any account information. For verification I’ll need you to provide any 2 of the following: date of birth, email, phone number, or mailing address (do not send any account numbers or sensitive documents).

A few important notes before we proceed:
- Because you plan to close your Light Blue checking account: Light Blue is an Entry Tier checking account. If it’s being closed within 30 days of opening, an early-closure fee of $15 may apply. Do you know when you opened that account?
- To open a new personal savings account as an agent on your behalf, our rules require you to have at least one active Rho-Bank checking account and that your checking account tenure be ≥14 days. So if you want me to open a savings account for you, please plan to open the new checking account first (I can open it for you now), then I can open the savings account and — if you want — transfer your $6,000 as the opening deposit.
- For the savings account APY: some checking+ savings pairings qualify for linked APY boosts (only specific pairings qualify and only the highest checking boost applies). If you want the absolute highest APY, tell me whether you prefer an account pair the system can link (I can show options/recommendations once you tell me what perks you care about in a checking account — e.g., ATM access, monthly fees waived, APY boost to savings, rewards).

Please confirm how you’d like to proceed and provide 2 of the identity fields (DOB, email, phone, or address). Also tell me:
1) Did you open the Light Blue account within the last 30 days? (yes/no/unsure)
2) Do you want me to: (A) just close the Light Blue account, (B) open a new checking account for you now, (C) open a new checking and a savings account and fund the savings from the new checking now? (You can pick one or ask for guidance.)

Once you provide the 2 verification fields and your choices, I’ll continue."
}
